incidents.name: NovaBox uninitialised dividend checkpoints
incidents.notes: NovaBox adds new dual ETH/NOVA depositors to the dividend list without initialising their dividend checkpoints, and its extcodesize guard is bypassed from a constructor, so a fresh depositor could immediately withdraw and collect the whole stale historical ETH dividend.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xbc4191167D4B0251cAB5201a527Daa8a7d3846b0 created 2018-10-11 by 0x01e806d7fca11320e96480f7a6e55ad98356237a, unrelated to attack sender; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; 56.73 ETH drained
